ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 65:35 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels to high-intensity (white/cream) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity region covering the central fluke area and extending to the leading edges. High-intensity mottled patches are localized on the distal regions of both lobes. Left lobe contains three distinct dark circular spots within the white patch. Right lobe features a larger white patch with multiple dark linear and punctate disruptions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 50 degrees at the central axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel-amplitudes along the entire trailing edge; significant jaggedness and peak-to-valley variance observed on the medial-to-distal sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the trailing edges, sweeping upward and outward to pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity, high-relief pixel groups (consistent with barnacle colonization) located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Multiple dark circular spots on the high-intensity regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, non-aligned dark linear pixel disruptions visible on the right lobe patch, including diagonal rake marks and one vertical mark near the outer margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized clusters of calcareous growth on the lobe tips; irregular serrated morphology along the trailing edge indicative of previous tissue loss.
